resident.required_for: Fishing for trout in nontidal waters
resident.note: Required in addition to annual license

nonresident.required_for: Fishing for trout in nontidal waters

trout_stamp.change_2025: Senior license no longer includes trout stamp - must be purchased separately

resident_annual.waters: Chesapeake Bay and tributaries, Atlantic coast, coastal bays

resident_senior_consolidated.eligibility: Age 65+ or becoming 65 in calendar year
resident_senior_consolidated.note: Major change in 2025 - seniors now must buy trout stamp separately

resident_boat_license.description: Allows owner or designee to fish both nontidal and tidal waters
resident_boat_license.benefit: Eliminates need for separate nontidal and Chesapeake Bay licenses if both purchased

resident_add_on.requirement: Must have Chesapeake Bay and Coastal Sport Fishing License
resident_add_on.eligibility: Those using trotline, collapsible traps, net rings, seines, or eel pots

recreational_crabbing_boat_license.permission: License holder or one other person on boat may crab

recreational_crabbing_license.exemption: Youth under 16 exempt with handlines/dip nets, limit 2 dozen crabs/day

100_percent_disabled_veteran.eligibility: 100% service-connected disabled veteran, former prisoner of war, or deemed unemployable by USDVA

under_16.requirement: NO LICENSE REQUIRED for any type of fishing

data.tidal_water_note: Anyone recreationally fishing in tidal waters must be licensed per MD Natural Resources Article 4-745

purchase_locations.in_person: Local license vendors (check DNR website for locations)
